This lot includes 12 antique glass telegraph and telephone line insulators, primarily Hemingray brand, featuring Hemingray-42 and Hemingray-17 markings. One insulator is marked H.G. CO. Selected Imported Briar
Carved Wooden Tobacco Smoking Pipe
Briar Wood, Ebonite Stem, Approximately 5.8 Inches Long
Classic estate smoking pipe crafted from imported briar wood, featuring decorative diagonal carved fluting across the bowl and distinct stamping along the shank. Briar root has long been the premier choice for traditional tobacco pipes due to its natural flame resistance, moisture absorption, and fine grain pattern. Mid-century estate pipes marked with the heraldic lion shield emblem and "Selected Imported Briar" stamping remain sought-after pieces for vintage tobacciana enthusiasts and collectors.
Shank stamped with heraldic lion in shield emblem and "SELECTED IMPORTED BRIAR"
Warm brown polished briar bowl with diagonal spiral carved grooves
Straight black tapered stem with bright metal trim ring at the shank junction
Measures approximately 5.8 inches long with a 1.2-inch bowl height
Condition:
Estate pre-owned condition. Briar finish shows light handling marks and surface wear consistent with age. Shank stamping is clear and legible. Chamber interior displays typical light carbonization from previous use. Stem fits snugly at the mortise with no cracks, chips, or structural repairs observed.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Brazilian Agate Geode Bookend
Polished Natural Agate with Blue Enhancement
Mid-to-Late 20th Century Lapidary Decor
This natural Brazilian agate geode section has been cut and polished to highlight intricate concentric banding and a crystalline quartz core, enhanced with a vibrant blue dye treatment. Popularized during the mid-to-late 20th century as functional desk accessories and display specimens, cut geode bookends highlight organic geological formations alongside geometric lapidary craftsmanship.
Natural agate geode featuring fine banding surrounding a crystalline quartz center
Polished front face and upright surface with preserved natural rough rind on the exterior
Equipped with three protective green felt pads on the base to prevent surface scratching
Measures approximately 5 inches tall, 3.5 inches long, and 2.5 inches wide, weighing 2.1 lbs
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The polished faces display a smooth, lustrous finish with clearly defined banding. The rough exterior shows typical geological texture and variations inherent to natural stone formation. Base felt pads are intact. Free of chips, cracks, or damage beyond natural mineral characteristics.

All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

Orders will ship via USPS, or FedEx services. Items may be marked as being shipped USPS but may come via FedEx and vice versa. If you want your item to be shipped a certain carrier please inform before paying for the item.
Any additional shipping instructions requested (I.E. individually wrapping items, duplicate boxes, etc) will require additional shipping charges to be paid by the customer. We will work with customers to fit their requests at the lowest possible shipping charge. Any order that totals equal to or greater than $120 will automatically require an indirect signature upon delivery. Any order that totals equal to or greater than $400 will automatically require an direct signature upon delivery. If you choose to negate this process you claim full responsibility for the delivery of the item as we provide the tracking information to you.
In the event a large item is won that is marked for local pickup only, you the buyer will have the option to have the item pick it up by a freight company at your expense.
Please note that all items ship in the order they are received and will ship within 5 business days (Excluding weekends and holidays) of the payment date.

description:
You are purchasing a "Mixed Rock and Mineral Collection Lot with Agate Slices" in "Used" condition.
Colorful mixed lot of rocks, minerals, and agate slices—perfect for collectors, crafters, educators, or anyone who loves natural stone. This unique bundle includes a wide variety of pieces, from rough rock specimens to polished tumbled stones and vibrant agate slices. You’ll see multiple shapes, sizes, and colors, along with a bag of mixed stones and a small display box of polished pieces. There is also a rectangular stone block with an animal outline and a printed information card for a Brazilian agate piece. Whether you tumble rocks, wire-wrap jewelry, teach geology, or just enjoy displaying interesting stones, this lot gives you an instant, varied collection with plenty to sort, study, and use in projects. Highlights: - Assorted tumbled stones in multiple colors - Rough rocks and mineral pieces with natural texture - Several polished agate slices in bright and neutral tones - One stone display box with polished stones - One larger stone block with an animal outline and info card - One bag filled with mixed stones for sorting or crafting Great for rock enthusiasts, classroom kits, craft projects, or decorating bowls, terrariums, and shelves. Keywords: rock collection, mixed stones lot, tumbled stones, agate slices, mineral specimens, rock hound, geology kit, craft stones, decorative rocks
Condition Notes:
Mixed lot of assorted rocks, minerals, and tumbled stones with visible handling wear. Some rough stones have chipped edges and natural surface irregularities. Tumbled stones appear generally smooth with minor scuffs. Agate slices show clean cuts with some edge wear and small surface scratches. The plastic display box has light surface wear and small marks. The bag of mixed stones shows no visible tears but is creased from handling. The carved rectangular stone block and other larger pieces show small nicks and surface scratches consistent with age and use.

title: Polished Gemstone & Crystal Wand Collection Quartz Cluster Selenite 2.2 lbs
description:
Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The specimens exhibit natural geological features, including internal fractures and surface textures inherent to natural minerals. The tumbled stones have a smooth, high-polish finish. The quartz cluster shows minor contact marks and natural inclusions typical of geological specimens.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
